title: What a material is
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: At the market, people may say material when they mean cloth.
Cloth is a material. But in science, the word means more than cloth.
A material is anything a thing is made of.
A football may be made of leather on the outside, and rubber inside.
A goal post may be made of metal or wood.
A market stall may have a wooden frame and a zinc roof.
So metal, wood, rubber, leather and glass are all materials, not only cloth.
Now it is your turn. Look at a thing and name what it is made of.
